work_history.title: Fund Accounting Supervisor
work_history.description: Supervised a team of fund accountants preparing financial statements and working papers for investment trust funds with NAV up to GBP 1bn, ensuring compliance with UK GAAP, IFRS and regulatory standards. Managed client and auditor queries on financial report preparation and classification to ensure timely delivery. Coordinated annual and interim financial statements, solvency statements and fund termination statements, ensuring precise asset valuation and transaction accounting with minimal audit adjustments. Drove automation of internal control and audit monitoring checklists for more accurate, efficient statement preparation.

Mentored and trained junior team members in financial reporting and fund accounting processes.
